title_zh: 修订保护区告示以明确步道限制

scenario.goal_zh: 依据已张贴规则说明不进入鸟类栖息地及禁止狩猎，并约定使用易懂文字

context_zh: 保护区工作人员检查一张待放在步道入口的新告示。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Our new sign says, 'Respect the habitat.' Will visitors know what that asks them to do?

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: Probably not. We should tell them to stay on the path and leave the reed beds alone.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Could we explain that repeated disturbance can harm the nesting birds?

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: Yes. That's clearer than just calling human activity harmful.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: The rules also prohibit hunting anywhere in the reserve. That needs its own line.

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: I'll put that underneath, with the ranger's contact number for questions.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Good. Let's use short sentences, so people can read the sign before entering.

targets.sense_zh: 动植物生活的自然栖息地
